welcome: Welcome to the Playdough Letter Factory! Pick a way to play.
roll: Roll the dough! Swipe back and forth.
nudge: Start at the glowing dot and follow the line.
word-cat: Can you make cat? C, A, T.
word-dog: Can you make dog? D, O, G.
word-sun: Can you make sun? S, U, N.
word-done: You made a word! Fantastic factory work!
free: Squish, stamp, and draw anything you can imagine!
